item.title: Countdown is on to the pre-season GAA tournaments
item.description: With the GAA season currently on the Christmas Break, the countdown is on to the pre-season tournaments at the begining of January. 2026 will see the return of the Bank of Ireland Dr. Mc Kenna cup with the usual format of the 9 counties been split into 3 groups. The top team from each group will go through to the semi final stage where they will be joined by the highest placed runner up. item.title: Popular 10k/5k run to held in Emyvale on New Years day
item.description: It is the time of the year for a number of traditional charity runs to be held across the region. One of the biggest will take place on New Years day with Glaslough Harriers and the Irish Yank Foundation holding their 10km and 5km in Emyvale. Registration for that event which will be raising funds for the Errigal Truagh Special Needs is now open. item.title: Former Cavan-Monaghan TD issues road safety warning
item.description: A former Fianna Fail TD for Cavan-Monaghan is encouraging people to be safe on the roads, particularly over this festive season. 184 people have been killed in road crashes so far in 2025, 17 more than this time last year. Margaret Conlon says the next number of days will be a peak time for festive travel, going to be more Gardai checkpoints between now and the New Year. item.title: €300,000 awarded to towards Castleblayney youth infrastructure
item.description: A number of local projects have been approved under the 2025 Town and Village Renewal Scheme. €300,000 has been awarded to Castleblayney towards infrastructure for children and teenagers in the area. The funding will see an internal fit-out of the community building at Mindszenty Park to provide shared, accessible indoor space for youth, sports, volunteer and educational groups. item.title: Cavan charity feeding hundreds of homeless people 365 days a year
item.description: A Kingscourt woman along with her family feed hundreds of homeless people in Dublin each week. Sonya McMahon says 'Help Our Homeless' that is run by her and her family offer food to the homeless in the city 365 days a year. She will feed up on 200 people two times a week outside the GPO along with a outreach service which operates seven days a week visiting tents in parks and beaches in the harder to reach areas across the capital. item.title: Monaghan farmers slams 'retaliatory' Chinese dairy tariffs
item.description: The IFA's Dairy Chair Martin McElearney has expressed disappointment at the introduction of tariffs by China on dairy goods, commencing today. The Co. Monaghan farmer said that the farm org understands that tariff rates will range from 21.9% to 42.7% and are predominantly focused on milk, cream and cheese. item.title: 24 new safety camera zones in Northern Sound region
item.description: There are 24 new safety camera zones identified in the Northern Sound region. Nationally, 390 new camera safety zones will become operational from the 1st of January 2026, this will bring the total number of safety camera zones nationwide to 1,901. Safety camera zones are identified high-risk locations and can include school safety zones, community engagement request zones and road works safety zones.
